official_statements.text: Texas portfolio totals 718 acres with up to 885 MW of secured and planned power capacity, including 271 acres with nearly 300 MW at our Sealy campus.

notes: Land and a land purchase option in Austin County bought from Priority Power Management on 2025-10-27 for $65.7M (cash, stock and deferred payment), plus adjacent land on 2026-04-17 for $15.1M (CleanSpark 10-Q, 2026-08-06, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/827876/000119312526338382/clsk-20260630.htm). CleanSpark calls it the Sealy campus: 271 acres, nearly 300 MW. The tenant that leased CleanSpark's Sandersville, GA AI campus signed a letter of intent and exclusivity over the whole 718-acre, 885 MW Texas portfolio (this site plus Brazoria) in July 2026. The 10-Q also mentions a temporary data center and battery storage moratorium imposed by Austin County in July 2026. Planned AI/HPC campus, not a bitcoin mine.

name: CleanSpark Brazoria campus

power_mw.unit: MW initial demand load (ERCOT approved), expandable to 600 MW

official_statements.text: 447 acres at the Brazoria campus, where transmission-level infrastructure supports an initial 300 MW demand load with the potential to expand to 600 MW.

notes: Real estate and land rights in Brazoria County bought 2026-02-27 for $28.7M, plus adjacent land 2026-05-28 for $9.6M (CleanSpark 10-Q, 2026-08-06, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/827876/000119312526338382/clsk-20260630.htm). ERCOT approved 300 MW in the quarter to March 2026 (CleanSpark release, 2026-05-11, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/827876/000119312526216866/clsk-ex99_1.htm). Under exclusivity with CleanSpark's Sandersville AI tenant since July 2026. Town not stated.

name: Soluna Project Rosa

power_mw.unit: MW (up to)

notes: Soluna 10-K (2026-03-30): 'We are developing Project Rosa in Snyder, Texas, which is expected to be up to 187 MW of data center capacity for AI and Bitcoin Hosting.' name: Project Comal (KDC, 1051 County Road 401, Taylor)

acres.unit: acres (site total; about 48 acres annexed and rezoned)

scrutiny.what: Residents raised concerns in November 2025 about traffic, health and environment; some did not want the data center in Taylor

news.title: Taylor approves land annexation for KDC data center
Big data center campus planned next to Samsung factory in Taylor

notes: 220-acre parcel at 1051 County Road 401, directly northeast of Samsung's Taylor chip plant (KXAN, Nov 2025). At least six large buildings planned. Taylor council unanimously approved annexation and zoning about March 26, 2026 (Spectrum, 2026-03-27). Stage 'permitted' = annexation and zoning approved; construction not confirmed by a non-tracker source. Investment of $2.5B as reported by Spectrum. Separate from the Big Watt / PowerHouse Taylor Technology Campus (tx-williamson-bigwatt-powerhouse-taylor): different developer, 664 acres, approved Oct 2026. Promotes lead tx-williamson-kdc-project-comal.

name: Rowan Project Temple

power_mw.unit: MW

water_use.value: Rowan says operations will use less than 0.5% of Temple's current water use

community_deal.value: $38M: $25M South Temple water infrastructure, $10M aquifer storage and recovery, $3M Sammons Community Center rebuild (if November bond passes); $13M of it a Cooperative Endeavor Contribution; council vote set Sept 17, 2026

news.title: Colorado Developer Secures $3B For Data Center Campus North Of Austin

notes: Near Bob White Road and Lorraine Avenue (Bisnow). Approved by Temple City Council and Bell County Commissioners Court; construction underway Jan 2026, operations expected 2027. Bisnow: 707 acres, first of three planned Temple campuses, about 1M sq ft; $3B green financing closed May 2026. Third building ('Lasso Building') on adjacent land in east Temple per Sept 2026 release. Separate from Meta Temple (tx-bell-meta-temple).

name: Rowan Cinco campus

power_mw.unit: MW

notes: Rowan broke ground Aug 2025 near Lytle, Medina County, outside San Antonio; fully operational projected 2027. $550M construction financing (rowan.com, Jan/Feb 2026); Rowan says local investment drives a 250% water offset (https://rowan.com/local-investment-drives-250-water-offset-at-cinco/). Release URL slug is odd but is Rowan's own page.

name: Google Wilbarger County data center

power_source.value: New clean power by AES co-located with or alongside the data center

official_statements.text: Google announced a new data center and clean energy in Wilbarger County, limiting water consumption to only critical campus operations like kitchens.

notes: Google blog (2026-02-24) announces 'a new data center and clean energy in Wilbarger County', with new clean power from AES co-located with or built alongside the campus; Google says it is under construction. Google's location list (read 2026-10-15) shows Wilbarger County, Texas as 'in development'. No town, acreage, MW or dollar figure published (Google's $40B Texas figure covers the whole state through 2027).

name: Google Pampa data center (with Meitner Energy Center)

power_source.value: Dedicated clean power from the Meitner Energy Center (Google and Intersect); technology not stated

notes: Google's location list (read 2026-10-15) shows 'Pampa, Texas' as in development. Google's Texas page links a June 4, 2026 Google/Intersect post announcing construction of the Meitner Energy Center with 'a new data center and energy investments in Gray and Roberts Counties'. County set to Gray County because Pampa is in Gray County; the post names no town and the data center itself could sit partly in Roberts County. No MW, acreage or dollar figure published.

name: Microsoft Pecos datacenter campus

power_source.value: Co-located behind-the-meter natural gas plant (SCR for NOx), later grid connection

cooling_type.value: Closed-loop cooling (initial fill only)

official_statements.text: Powering the next wave of AI: Expanding capacity with our new datacenter in Pecos (multibillion-dollar campus over five to seven years).

notes: Microsoft blog (Noelle Walsh, 2026-06-22): multibillion-dollar datacenter campus outside Pecos over five to seven years, powered at launch by a co-located behind-the-meter natural gas plant with SCR, later tied to the grid; closed-loop cooling; over 6,000 construction jobs at peak and hundreds of permanent jobs. The '2 GW' figure in the post is Microsoft's overall capacity expansion, not a site figure. Not the same as Core Scientific's Pecos campus (tx-reeves-corescientific-pecos).

name: Microsoft Lambda Drive datacenter campus (Texas Research Park)

official_statements.text: Microsoft is developing a datacenter campus on Lambda Drive in San Antonio, Texas.

notes: Microsoft local page: 'Microsoft is developing a datacenter campus on Lambda Drive in San Antonio, Texas'; first phase of development, with later construction afterward. DCD (lead): Texas Research Park, 15000 Lambda Drive, 158 acres owned, plans for $1B and 1M sq ft; SAT40 shell filed with TDLR in 2023. Separate from the Westover Hills campus (tx-bexar-microsoft-san-antonio). Promoted from lead tx-bexar-microsoft-texas-research-park.

name: Crusoe / Blue Energy Port of Victoria AI data center campus

power_source.value: Blue Energy plant: natural gas first (2028), then nuclear up to 1,500 MW (2031)

notes: Crusoe release (2025-10-30): Blue Energy and Crusoe to develop a nuclear-powered AI data center campus at the Port of Victoria; 'The 1,600-acre Crusoe campus located in Calhoun County' (correction note: an earlier draft wrongly said Victoria County). Gas-fired power as early as 2028, nuclear (up to 1.5 GW, gas-to-nuclear conversion) by 2031. Promoted from lead tx-victoria-crusoe-port-of-victoria.

name: Ionic Digital Cedarvale facility (Nscale for Microsoft)

power_mw.unit: MW

official_statements.text: Ionic Digital 10-Q: Ward County facility leased to a single tenant; lease commenced December 19, 2025, term through January 2037, fixed lease payments about $1.9 billion.

news.title: Nscale Wins $14B Microsoft AI Deal, Secures Texas Site via Lease with Ionic Digital
Microsoft Cuts Fourth Nscale Deal With Texas AI Data Center

notes: Ionic Digital 10-Q for Q2 2026 (SEC, filed 2026-09-01): the Ward County facility is leased to a single tenant under a lease signed 2025-10-14, lease commencement 2025-12-19, term to January 2037, about $1.9B fixed payments; a February 2026 amendment adds 89 MW when available. The Energy Mag (2025-10-15): Nscale leases the Cedarvale facility in Barstow, full 234 MW (about 240 MW), for about 104,000 Nvidia GB300 chips for Microsoft; Microsoft option to add 700 MW from late 2027. Bloomberg Government (2025-10-15): Nscale's Texas site for Microsoft opens Q3 2026. Former Celsius bitcoin mine. Stage kept at building: running not confirmed. Ionic's four Midland bitcoin sites are not added here.
